verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents a first-party Blob Storage Export feature for exporting large volumes on a schedule, which covers the core bulk-to-blob-storage part of the story. The evidence consists only of overview-table mentions, though: it never says which entities are exported (traces versus datasets), and it never mentions warehouse destinations or formats. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that traces and datasets are included in exports, documented data-warehouse destinations or formats, in-depth export docs and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-export traces and datasets to blob storage or my data warehouse
